faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Find quick answers to the most common questions about <brand>ORIVEX</brand>.

booking.question: How do I book an appointment?
booking.answer: Find a doctor by specialty or name, choose an available time, and submit your request. Your doctor reviews and approves every booking before it's confirmed.

becomeDoctor.question: How do I become a doctor on ORIVEX?
becomeDoctor.answer: Register for an account, then complete the doctor onboarding wizard with your professional details and license documents. Your application is reviewed before you can start practicing.

verification.question: How does verification work?
verification.answer: Both patients and doctors verify their identity — doctors also submit their professional credentials for admin review before they can accept patients.

consultations.question: Are consultations online?
consultations.answer: Yes. Consultations happen over secure video, directly in your browser — no extra software required.

prescriptions.question: How do prescriptions work?
prescriptions.answer: Your doctor can issue a digital prescription during your consultation, which you can then view and print from your medical records.
